tagline: Nothing is uploaded. The invite is the room. Works on a plane.
description:
Type a password, a note, an API token. It is encrypted in this tab. Nothing is uploaded — there is no Yopass website in the middle, no Redis, no Go server, and no account. Press Invite in the bar above the app: whoever opens the link is in the one-time room and can read it. Optionally burn it after the first look, optionally a passphrase they still have to type, optionally a 1 hour / 1 day / 1 week timer.

The ciphertext lives in this file on this device, and in the room while people are connected. It works on a plane.

An unofficial port of Yopass by Johan Haals. Same job — share a secret without putting it in a chat in the clear. Not their backend, and not their OpenPGP bytes.
